Name: CutTheCord
Author: cgifox
Description:
A simple briefing to start the day!

Things currently shown in the daily brief:
[list]
[*]Weather forecast
[*]Fortune
[*]Livin' Off The Land
[*]The Queen of Sauce
[*]Number of letters(if any) in the mailbox
[/list]


[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Just wake up and you'll see a message with the day's briefing

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[/list]

[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*] Source code - [url=https://github.com/harshlele/CutTheCord]https://github.com/harshlele/CutTheCord[/url]
[/list]
